offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures quality control instruments, sterilization indicators and monitoring systems, and sample preparation equipment for pharmaceutical, medical device, food and laboratory customers, sold directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: biological indicators; chemical indicators; temperature data loggers; sample homogenizers; sterilization monitoring instruments

primary_services.value: instrument calibration; testing services; cloud data monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, hospitals, clinical and food testing laboratories

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; medical devices; food and beverage; clinical laboratories; life sciences research

revenue_model.value: product sales: instruments, indicators and consumables sold to laboratories and manufacturers; service fees: calibration, testing and monitoring services; subscription: recurring software and monitoring subscriptions for data loggers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes its own instruments and indicators, sold to pharma, device and lab customers; brand owner: markets own-brand products also sold through partners; software / platform: cloud data platform for monitored equipment and sterilization records
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Sells worldwide, with major operations in the United States and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: quality control instruments, sterilization indicators, data loggers and sample preparation equipment serving similar lab and manufacturing customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to large pharmaceutical and device accounts; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors covering smaller labs and regional markets; online: online ordering for consumables and replacement parts
